legend: The bone marrow trephine shows a densely cellular bone marrow with a prominent blastic component (<<39565>>). There is a dense reticulin network (<<39564>>). The blasts are positive for KIT (CD117) (<<39562>>) and CD42 (<<39560>>).

A low-power view of a blood film with many blasts (<<39561>>). A higher-power view of a blood smear with blasts, including one that is partially differentiated towards an abnormal megakaryocyte and a megakaryocyte fragment (i.e. a huge platelet, larger than a red cell) (<<39563>>).
